git-governance.description: Git branch and repository governance semantics.

operations-core.description: Cross-domain operational identity, observation, and action semantics.

transition-protocol.description: Verifiable mutation plan and receipt semantics.

action.operational.definition: Cross-domain operational action vocabulary: CONTINUE, RECONCILE, HANDOFF, PAUSE, NEEDS_HUMAN.

artifact.agent-semantic-brief.definition: Read-only contextual projection of relevant capabilities and a bounded selection of non-authoritative maxims.

artifact.capability-relevance-projection.definition: Deterministic coverage projection that keeps required, available, conditional and unavailable capabilities explicit.

artifact.ecosystem-maxim.definition: Non-authoritative cultural recommendation with an owner, justification, misread risk and death condition.

artifact.git-mutation-bundle.definition: Read-only exact-content Git mutation intent and tree/readback proof; it never authorizes mutation.

artifact.receipt.definition: Evidence emitted only after a mutation is applied and verified by readback.

artifact.recommendation.definition: Read-only policy interpretation that does not itself authorize mutation.

artifact.remote-canonical-command.definition: Closed non-authoritative remote execution command whose exact target and expected preconditions are normalized by the canonical execution host.

artifact.remote-canonical-execution-rece.definition: Hash-bound aggregate receipt proving a remote canonical command was planned, applied through the correct writer or governed Git path, and read back.

artifact.remote-canonical-request.definition: Closed read-only request that binds remote planning intent, expected authorities, scope, planner identity and request hash; it never authorizes mutation.

artifact.roadmap-freshness-inspection.definition: Read-only proof that known consumers were explicitly reviewed when mutable ProjectState direction changed.

artifact.routing-plan.definition: Read-only routing decision without transport side effects.

artifact.sanitization-plan.definition: Plan describing potentially destructive maintenance; execution requires a separate guarded executor.

artifact.transition-plan.definition: Deterministic mutation candidate bound to before-state and exact plan identity.

branch.class.authority.definition: Branch class reserved for an explicitly declared live authority; the name alone never grants authority.

branch.class.experiment.definition: Branch class for bounded experimental work; the name does not imply retention or promotion.

branch.class.work.definition: Branch class for transient implementation work; the name does not imply deletion eligibility.

branch.domain.engine.definition: Semantic branch domain for Engine/runtime implementation work.

branch.domain.operations.definition: Semantic branch domain for operational framework and GitOps work.

branch.domain.ui.definition: Semantic branch domain for UI implementation work.

capability.ecosystem.definition: Governed ecosystem feature whose lifecycle is represented by Capability Policy and gates.

capability.logical.definition: Provider-neutral operational ability defined by required invariants rather than a concrete executable.

capability.policy.definition: Current capability policy vocabulary: experimental, canonical, deprecated, disabled.

coordination.intent.definition: Advisory planned-write record in the Coordination authority; it is not a lease, assignment or authorization.

coordination.lease.definition: Temporary exclusive write ownership over an exact coordination resource.

core.authority.definition: Canonical source for a mutable operational fact within a domain.

core.canonical-writer.definition: The single supported mutation surface for one mutable authority.

core.projection.definition: Derived representation that never becomes an independent source of truth.

guidance.maxim.definition: Short non-authoritative cultural reminder that never overrides a contract or authorizes mutation.

identity.role.definition: Logical function fulfilled by one or more workers.

identity.session.definition: Ephemeral execution instance of a worker.

identity.worker.definition: Persistent identifiable executor of a logical role.

identity.worker-reference.definition: Reference to a worker identity from another operational contract.

intent.declared.definition: Contextual objective supplied to a projection; it is not Work, CoordinationIntent, assignment or authority.

runtime.provider.definition: Runtime or carrier exposing concrete features without acquiring semantic authority by its existence.

status.observation.definition: Epistemic observation status: PASS means required facts were observed and validated; UNKNOWN means they could not be determined; FAIL means required factual observation or contract validation failed.

status.work.definition: Persistent work lifecycle vocabulary: READY, IN_PROGRESS, WAITING, HANDOFF, DONE.

surface.tool.definition: Concrete invocable interface such as a CLI, connector tool or workflow entrypoint.

work.dependency.definition: Directed dependsOn relation between persistent work items. Dependencies are resolved only when the referenced work item is DONE.

work.graph.definition: Read-only deterministic graph derived from work items and their dependsOn relations; never an independent authority.

work.item.definition: Persistent unit of executable work stored in the existing continuations authority.

agent.cycle.hosted.description: Run canonical Agent Cycle begin/close on a hosted carrier with hash-bound begin artifact and exact-source close readback.

capability.lifecycle.inspect.description: Inspect capability policy, gates, and deterministic transition eligibility.

capability.lifecycle.mutate.description: Apply a planned capability lifecycle transition through the canonical capability executor.

coordination.guard.inspect.description: Inspect whether a declared owner may write exact Coordination resources.

coordination.mutate.description: Mutate Coordination through its canonical planner, CAS update, trusted time, and readback.

git.branch-governance.apply.description: Apply a validated branch sanitization plan with exact ref preconditions and readback.

git.branch-governance.plan.description: Build a deterministic branch retention and sanitization plan from observed refs and Work evidence.

git.direct-mutation.description: Materialize an exact Git content or topology mutation through blob, tree, commit, non-force ref update, and readback.

git.direct-mutation.plan.description: Build and verify a read-only GitMutationBundle bound to exact content and ref preconditions.

git.local-read.description: Read local Git objects, refs, diffs, and worktree state without remote mutation.

github.artifact.read.description: Read a workflow artifact with provenance retained.

github.ci.read.description: Read commit and pull-request CI state.

github.expected-head-write.description: Perform a GitHub write bound to an exact observed head and non-force update.

github.git-data.write.description: Create Git blobs, trees, and commits without moving refs.

github.mutation-readback.description: Independently read back content and refs after a GitHub mutation.

github.pr.read.description: Read pull-request metadata, diff scope, and merge state.

github.ref.read.description: Read exact GitHub branch and tag refs.

github.remote-time.description: Observe trusted remote time for time-bound authority transitions.

github.repository.read.description: Read repository metadata and content from GitHub.

integration.reconcile.plan.description: Build a read-only integration reconciliation plan for a pull request.

maintenance.inspect.description: Derive deterministic maintenance findings without performing maintenance.

peer.recovery.plan.description: Compare peer health evidence and derive a bounded non-authoritative recovery recommendation.

project-state.mutate.description: Apply a validated ProjectState transition through its canonical writer and readback.

project.bootstrap.inspect.description: Inspect current ProjectState and bootstrap surfaces without claiming assignment.

project.inspect.description: Build a closed read-only ProjectMachine inspection from canonical observations.

remote.canonical.execute.description: Execute a closed remote canonical command through repository planners, existing domain writers or the governed direct-Git path, then emit aggregate readback evidence.

roadmap.freshness.inspect.description: Verify hash-bound review coverage for current-state narrative consumers.

routine.inspect.description: Evaluate registered recurring read-only obligations over a closed inspection.

runtime.capabilities.inspect.description: Resolve provider-neutral runtime capability availability from normalized provider observations.

runtime.observations.validate.description: Validate a closed read-only external runtime observation bundle.

scheduler.plan.description: Derive a deterministic routing plan without transport side effects.

scheduler.snapshot.description: Build and validate a deterministic supervisor snapshot.

semantics.inspect.description: Resolve and validate OperationalSemantics contracts and topology.

supervisor.snapshot-consume.description: Consume a validated supervisor snapshot only when artifact, CI, and ref evidence are available.

work.lifecycle.mutate.description: Mutate Work through the canonical Continuation planner, CAS update, and readback.

work.lifecycle.probe.description: Exercise the bounded Work lifecycle probe through the canonical writer.

gh-api.description: GitHub REST access through the authenticated gh API carrier.

github-connector.description: Connected GitHub tool surface exposing normalized repository operations.

local-git.description: Local Git executable used for repository and object inspection.

local-python.description: Local Python module execution surface for repository tooling.

validated-workflow-artifact.description: Previously produced workflow artifact whose provenance and content have been validated.

exclusions.reason: Product-domain CI is outside the operational tool-surface map.
exclusions.deathCondition: Remove when Scene Core CI becomes an explicit operational capability surface.

exclusions.reason: Product-domain CI is outside the operational tool-surface map.
exclusions.deathCondition: Remove when Viewer Next CI becomes an explicit operational capability surface.
